fixed.provider_endpoint: z.ai (api.z.ai), anthropic-compatible base https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic for the claude harness

sampling_rule: every footnote node whose PR merged 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28, PR added at least one new test file, tests under 10 minutes; systematic sample of 10 (k=round(N/10), offset k/2), epic/meta excluded; prompt carries no sha and no PR number
stop_rule: stop and report when the next attempt would pass the ceiling; never raise it
decision_rules: a: opencode or zcode beats claude-code on accepted changes, or matches at 30% lower cost per accepted change -> recommend GLM routing change in config.routing.models (recommendation only)
b: every external harness shares one named GLM failure a loop change would fix -> name it as the child-3 deficiency target
c: no arm differs beyond noise (about 15 points at this n) -> record it and recommend closing the native branch (AC4-EDGE)
an arm under 20 graded attempts is underpowered and fires no rule alone
prices_note: GLM-5.3-Flash list price from the z.ai pricing page, read 2026-09-29: input 0.15, cached input 0.03, output 0.50 USD per 1M tokens. z.ai lists no cache-write charge and bills written tokens as input, so cache write is 0.15. The report prices by the exact model string, so every string an arm can report carries the same rates. An unlisted string reads unmeasured.

amendment_1.run0_repeats_reason: Run 0 is one pass per arm over the 89 Terminal-Bench 2 tasks, paired by task. The 3-repeat rule applies to Run 1.
amendment_1.run0_timeout: each Terminal-Bench 2 task's own agent timeout at timeout_multiplier 1.0; the 45m budget applies to Run 1
amendment_1.run0_reference_model: Terminus 2 runs glm-5.3-flash through z.ai like every other arm; the Sonnet price row is removed
amendment_1.concurrency: one Harbor job at a time with n_concurrent_trials 4; Run 1 runs one attempt at a time beside Run 0
amendment_1.stop_rule_granularity: before each Harbor job, spent USD plus 3 x the arm's smoke cost per task x 89 must stay under the ceiling; before each Run 1 lane, spent USD plus 3 x the lane's projection must stay under it

amendment_4.scope: attempts that never started; no grade or rule changes
amendment_4.docker_down: a Run 0 trial whose docker environment never started is an infrastructure exclusion; harbor jobs resume -f RuntimeError reruns it in place; unrun arms run in the same seeded order
amendment_4.provider_cap: a Run 1 spawn refused before the worker starts reads unavailable; a top-up pass reruns missing graded attempts up to 3 per task, at most 3 passes; each refusal stays counted by reason
amendment_4.started_attempts: a started attempt or trial is never rerun; it is scored as it stands
amendment_4.stalls: a Run 1 worker that exhausts its 45m budget (spawn exit 12 opencode, 124 claude) started; the runner files it unavailable with no grade; this study scores it as a stall, an attempt with no accepted change, and prints each rate with and without stalls

amendment_5.scope: work a machine restart killed in flight; no grade or rule changes
amendment_5.restart: machine boot 2026-09-30T12:21:17Z; last Harbor log write 10:43:47Z; last Run 1 row 09:43:11Z
amendment_5.run_0: a trial that wrote no result is run again by harbor jobs resume; a trial that wrote a result stands; unrun arms run in the same seeded order
amendment_5.resume_token: harbor stores the token masked in the job config; the first resume (14:13Z to 14:33Z) sent it masked; 4 reruns ended in HTTP 401 with zero tokens and 4 were in setup; none reached the model; all 8 are parked and run again; an opencode job that started out of order was stopped before any agent ran and starts fresh after the claude-code arm
amendment_5.pause: 1-minute load 359 on 12 cores at 16:43Z; both runs paused at 16:45:48Z on the fleet lead's order; harbor has no drain, so 4 claude-code trials and 1 opencode attempt in flight stopped with no result and run again on resume; every written result stands
amendment_5.load: from 16:40Z a sampler records the load average once a minute; the results print load beside each timeout and stall, and each rate again without results that ran above load 50; no load record exists before 16:40Z
amendment_5.run_1: the opencode lane finishes through the top-up script in one pass; the zcode lane runs next; then the top-up runs its 3 passes over the claude and opencode lanes

amendment_6.scope: a new machine; no grade or rule changes
amendment_6.machine: the user's Intel iMac (x86_64, 128 GB); task images are linux/amd64 and the first machine (arm64) emulated them
amendment_6.pilot: every result from the arm64 Mac, Run 0 and Run 1, is a pilot; reported apart; fires no decision rule
amendment_6.restart: both runs restart clean on the iMac: Run 0 smokes first, then the same seeded arm order; Run 1 the same seeded lane order, then the top-up
amendment_6.concurrency: Run 0 runs min(4, floor(physical cores / 2)) trials at once; Run 1 one attempt at a time beside it
amendment_6.scripts: run scripts live in evals/harness-fit/run/; evals/harness-fit/setup-imac.sh installs Docker, Harbor, the harness CLIs and the key; the zcode adapter stays out of the repo, so zcode reads unavailable unless its files are copied in
amendment_6.account: same z.ai account and key; the 1302 rule stays
amendment_6.dollars: the pilot spend counts against the 200 USD ceiling
amendment_6.pilot_spend_basis: Run 0 Harbor jobs 2.54 + Run 1 priced rows 2.36 + 2.00 floor for 8 unmeasured opencode stalls (0.25 each) = 6.90, rounded up
